title: No original-circle-equivariant observation into H_ps is injective on a faithful source action

noninjectivity.source_hypothesis: The C-action on X is faithful.
noninjectivity.witness: Faithfulness implies z is not the identity transformation, so some x satisfies z.x!=x.
noninjectivity.collision: K1716 gives F(z.x)=F(x) for that distinct pair.
noninjectivity.conclusion: No C-equivariant set map F:X->H_ps is injective; linearity and primitive weight decompositions are unnecessary.
noninjectivity.exact_reopener: Injectivity requires at least one change: quotient the source by H, use a target on which z acts nontrivially, break original-circle equivariance, or add separately owned z-sensitive output data.

claim_ceiling: K1713's linear primitive-intertwiner obstruction strengthens to arbitrary equivariant set maps on any faithful source C-action. It does not exclude nonfaithful physical sources, other circles, non-equivariant observations, or a source-selected effective quotient.
